replacements.text: Strongest feature: Craig identifies the decisive inference: libertarian freedom excludes causal determination, so omnipotence cannot guarantee free choices; distinguishing logically possible from creature-feasible worlds directly answers Flew’s obedient-creation proposal. Principal limitation: This conceptual evidence yields contradiction only assuming libertarianism, without independently vindicating it or explaining why omniscience could not select agents whose foreknown undetermined choices remain consistently good. Live burden: Craig must defend libertarian alternatives and feasibility constraints, while Flew must explain how noncoercive divine influence guarantees right conduct without determination or substitution of compatibilism. Locked score: The exact 81 reflects responsiveness 88, precision and clarity 86, logical coherence 83, relevance and burden 82, evidence warrant 71, and calibration and charity 74: an incisive modal rebuttal, moderated because its governing freedom model remains insufficiently established.

Strongest feature: Flew corrects Craig’s coercion reconstruction and supplies Thomistic evidence for the alternative that divine agency can constitute or move willing according to its nature without external violence, restoring the freely-obedient-creation challenge. Principal limitation: Aquinas establishes an available model, not that infallibly moved action preserves Craig’s libertarian alternatives; consequently, Flew risks changing freedom theories without defeating Craig’s inference internally. Live burden: Flew must distinguish constitution, guidance, determination, voluntariness, and genuine freedom to show guaranteed goodness is noncoercive, while Craig must justify treating libertarianism and feasibility constraints as controlling. Locked score: The exact 77 reflects responsiveness 85, calibration and charity 80, relevance and burden 79, precision and clarity 76, logical coherence 74, and evidence warrant 72: a pointed clarification whose indispensable compatibility claim remains unresolved.
